title: Sycophancy under Pressure: Evaluating and Mitigating Sycophantic Bias via Adversarial Dialogues in Scientific QA
reasoning: The paper focuses on sycophancy and truthfulness in the context of scientific question answering (QA). While it mentions that sycophantic behavior can lead to aligning with 'ethically questionable' user beliefs, the core of the study is a benchmark of factual reasoning in science (using GPQA and ARC datasets) and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
